header.nodes_are: the 656 non-manual movable routes (manual/frozen routes are excluded: they have no degree of freedom)
header.edge_set: union of (a) every frozen-baseline crossing pair, (b) every pair of same-group movable routes whose straight port-to-port chords properly cross (= topology risk: an alternating pair cannot share a physical height without a crossing while its ports stay pinned)

compact_arrays.topology_reason: same indexing as topology; look the text up in header.topology_reason[]
compact_arrays.edges: parallel arrays, one entry per edge; route_a/route_b are indices into nodes[], family_a/family_b are indices into families[], topology is an index into topology_values
compact_arrays.bbox_overlap_xy: overlap area in mm^2 of the axis-aligned bounding boxes of the two routes full flat geometry (all heights)
compact_arrays.note: comma separated flags: baseline_crossing, same_baseline_plane, same_family

topology_reason: direct/direct interface-body flats with alternating ports: forced while both routes stay direct (Jordan curve)
port chords do not alternate: same-height 2D re-pathing can separate the pair
port chords alternate but the flats attach to interior stub ends: needs height separation, a same-height order-preserving embedding does not exist
